name: scene-1
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. ONE portrait 1024x1536 coloring-book sheet for a FOUR-YEAR-OLD, redrawn from the supplied scene. Show small friendly PinPin hedgehog carefully lifting a fallen branch with BOTH front paws to free a little plant beneath it. Make the plant's three big heart-shaped leaves large and clearly separated from the lifted branch; branch stays ABOVE the leaves, no crushing or tangled anatomy. Show the child fully visible from head to feet, behind the branch, concentrating kindly on the plant. Recompose vertically as a big simple close view of the interaction. Keep only a plain little patch of ground and one small rock, no busy forest. Pure BLACK heavy clean outlines on OPAQUE PURE WHITE #FFFFFF paper, including every interior and the entire background; NO transparency. Large enclosed white regions for thick crayons. Quills simplified to a zigzag outer silhouette with at most four big inside shapes. Branch has smooth outline and one knot, no bark texture. Plant leaves each one center vein only. Tiny pupils can be black. Absolutely no gray, shading, shadows, gradients, fine fur, hatching, color, letters, text, page border or panels. Generous margins, no cropping.

review.notes: Two clear paws lift branch above three broad heart leaves; large crayon regions, white opaque paper.
